title: Eric Davis calls Townsend Brown a phony

tellings.quote: um Eric Davis got in touch with me and was like Towns and Brown is a a phony.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a man named Eric Davis got in touch with him, around 2024, and told him that Townsend Brown was "a phony." Brown is a figure whose name comes up in these stories about advanced propulsion. It matters because it would cast doubt on claims tied to Brown's work.
